verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes versioned Postman collections for its API (gusto-docs-68) and has structured, versioned reference docs (gusto-docs-67, gusto-docs-69), which are machine-readable-adjacent artifacts, but there is no explicit mention of a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file or equivalent standard schema. missing for 10: explicit OpenAPI/Swagger spec, a documented download link or endpoint for the raw spec, and confirmation of spec format/versioning compatibility with standard tooling.
